# Buttercup Advertising Studio

> Award-winning creative branding, brand strategy, visual identity, 3D packaging architecture, and advertising agency based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Led by Creative Director & Founder Sneha Vakta Shah. Serving ambitious founders across India, United States, United Kingdom, UAE (Dubai), Canada, and Singapore.

Buttercup Advertising Studio (BAS) engineers category-defining brand identities, commercial brand narratives, shelf-dominating packaging design, and modern interactive web experiences. We combine senior creative directorship with agile sprints, eliminating agency bureaucracy and delivering measurable market dominance.

## Global & Local Geographic Reach (GEO)
- **Headquarters**: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India (Coordinates: 23.022505° N, 72.571362° E)
- **India National Footprint**: Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot.
- **International Client Hubs**: United States (New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles), United Kingdom (London), United Arab Emirates (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Canada (Toronto, Vancouver), Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia (Sydney, Melbourne).

## Core Capabilities
- [Brand Strategy & Positioning](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/brand-strategy/): Market positioning, audience persona architecture, competitor whitespace mapping, brand manifestos, and core tone-of-voice.
- [Visual Identity & Design Systems](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/): Bespoke brandmarks, custom typography, comprehensive Figma design systems, Pantone color palettes, and corporate brand guidelines.
- [Packaging Design & 3D CGI Architecture](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/visual-identity/): Retail shelf dominance ("The 3-Second Shelf Battle"), structural die-lines, 3D photo-realistic renders, tactile finishes (embossing, hot foil stamping, spot UV), and FSSAI/FDA regulatory compliance.
- [Marketing Communication & Campaigns](https://buttercup.in/pages/services/marketing-communication/): Omnichannel launch campaigns, social media narratives, film direction, digital ads, and B2B distributor collateral.
- [Product Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/product-base/): Branding for FMCG, Food & Beverage, Ayurvedic Wellness, Luxury Jewelry, Cosmetics, Pharmaceuticals, Textiles, Industrial Engineering, and Medical Devices.
- [Service Base Industries](https://buttercup.in/pages/industries/service-base/): Branding for Real Estate & Architecture, SaaS & FinTech, Healthcare, Hospitality, Venture Capital, and Professional Consulting.

## Flagship Case Studies
- [Abode](https://buttercup.in/projects/abode.html): Luxury sustainable architecture & editorial monograph.
- [Vriksh Ayurveda](https://buttercup.in/projects/vriksh.html): Organic Ayurvedic skincare & botanical glass packaging.
- [Swaad Gourmet](https://buttercup.in/projects/swaad.html): Appetite-inducing gourmet FMCG packaging & retail dominance.
- [Aura Smart Tech](https://buttercup.in/projects/aura.html): Futuristic lifestyle tech visual identity & premium hardware unboxing.
- [Jimmy Mixers](https://buttercup.in/projects/jimmy.html): Bold cocktail mixer packaging & retro-modern typography.
- [Titano LED](https://buttercup.in/projects/titano-led.html): Architectural commercial lighting & B2B distributor catalog architecture.
- [Senal Diamonds](https://buttercup.in/projects/senal-diamonds.html): Luxury fine jewelry monogram & high-end tactile packaging.
- [Beatitude](https://buttercup.in/projects/beatitude.html): Premium handcrafted apparel identity & kinetic brand system.
- [Coin Dhan](https://buttercup.in/projects/coin-dhan.html): FinTech enterprise SaaS analytics & digital experience.
